With that said, I saturated a cotton round and applied onto my end-of-day waterproof mascara lashes. I held it for about a minute and to my utter shock, there was hardly any mascara transferred onto the cotton round. So I swiped some more and removed some of the mascara, but most of it was still on my lashes! Had I been using my other micellar water, I would have fully removed everything by then. For years I had my eye on this Micellar water, but it was always so expensive and when I finally found it fairly priced on Amazon, I jumped on it and purchased. If your buying this for waterproof mascara removal, keep on looking bc this does not work for that. It removed my eye shadow nicely, but so does my other half priced micellar water that I'm going to keep using instead of this.

title: If what you're using ain't broke, don't fix it!
date: Bewertet in den USA am9. März 2026
review: I was in denial for a while because this product isn't cheap and it works well for so many others, but it's drying my skin out! By the time I'd finish removing my makeup, my skin felt sucked dry and also irritated by the rubbing of the cotton pad. My skin was struggling with water retention and dehydration in the 3 months of using this. I've never experienced this issue with other makeup remover wipes or cleansing balms. Not even with the Garnier micellar water dupe. It's also by far the worst at removing my mascara, which isn't even waterproof.I switched to this product because I thought it'd be more natural and better for me since its fragrance free and claims to be gentler. I've never been one to have sensitive skin. It's always been fairly normal and balanced. My skincare routine, which has been the same for years and served me well, wasn’t enough to balance out the disruption this product caused on a daily basis.They say you don't have to wash it off, but when I'd use it to remove my sunscreen after a day of no makeup and no cleansing, my skin would breakout and feel grimy the next day. My skin felt "too clean" using it the mornings. I would also get oilier in the day and makeup wasn't sitting right, prompting me to wear lots of powder when I didn't used to need it before.I noticed my skin improved again when I stopped using this product entirely. I'm sad because I really wanted to like it! I stubbornly gave it every chance I could. I thought since everyone else liked it, I must be the one doing something wrong. I desperately bought new moisturizer and drank more water. Unfortunately, this is just too stripping for me. The pump is cute and reusable though!

Tal vez  tenía que haber cogido la versión de tapa azul " HYDRABIO " que es la indicada para pieles secas o muy secas. Si cogí esta es porque muchas personas que dicen que tienen el mismo tipo de piel que yo (mixta tirando a seca ) esta les daba buenos resultados y " sensación de frescor " .RESULTADO PERSONAL :No es que deje la piel de la cara seca (como si puede hacerlo echarte agua muy caliente ) y tirante, pero al menos a mi personalmente si que me da " sensación " de sequedad y en un par de puntos de la barbilla me ha dejado sensación (algo parecido a cuando te estan saliendo granos rojos de esos que duelen ) inmediatamente acabar la limpieza facial. Una hora despues la sensación ha pasado y no tengo nada ni me va a salir nada pero entonces he empezado a tener sensación de sequedad en la frente.CONCLUSIÓN :En el mercado existe una gran variedad de productos que ofrencen cumplir la misma función y dejan mejores resultados. Definitivamente este producto no es para mi. Las soluciones bifásicas van mejor para mi. Tanto si es una barata del mercadona como si es una cara con agua de rosas de Lâncome que es la que usaba mi parienta en casa aunque de esa no me gusta el olor.Seguire probando productos hasta que encuentre el ideal para mi. Auguro que con HIDROLATO DE ROSAS ( agua de rosas ) sin más ofrecerá buenos resultados y de la forma mas natural. Si no que se lo digan a Hannan Beauty. Una youtuber de origen marroquí que tiene 40 y parece que tiene 30. Sus consejos bien aplicados dan buenos resultados. Me decidí a probar esto por Martin Catalogne. Un youtuber maquillador profesional peruano que bajo mi criterio personal tambien sabe lo que hace y se cuida bastante bien. Usa aceite de coco etc. Pero en este caso me temo que diferimos. No me ha gustado la experiencia con este agua micelar. Supongo que no es para mi.Seguire probando cosas y me pasaré al hidrolato de rosas. También probaré mi propio " bifásico"  a base de emulsionar aceite se oliva virgen suave con leche, ya que desmaquillarse con un algodon con aceite y despues con leche para quitar el exceso de aceite también funciona bastante bien, hidrata, es respetuoso con la piel y la deja radiante, elástica, aporta un toque de colorcillo dorado que favorece la piel y deja sensaxion y aspecto muy sano. Al final siempre llego a la misma conclusión, es dificil igualar lo que la materia ya ofrece de forma natural. De forma muy economica y con un minimo esfuerzo.SI ALGUIEN QUIERE COMPARTIR SU EXPERIENCIA O RECOMENDACIONES CONMIGO SE LO AGRADECERÉ.GRACIAS !!

I just couldn't stand that feeling as I always use my facial cleaners to get rid of oil based makeup remover products. I guess most people would think I'm crazy as the rinse-off part is supposed to be unnecessary with any micellar water. I don't know why but I just don't think it is right to not rince it off as that part has always been my routine with my 8 years' using Lancôme's bi-facil eye makeup remover which is also an oil based product. Another thing I dislike is it's got a very bad bitter chemical taste. I use it to remove my lipsticks and I actually have to rince it off my lips or I would find myself gagging over the bad taste later when I accidentally licked my lips. A notable good thing about this product is that this product does not make my skin feel irritated even though I have super sensitive dry skin. Anyways it's a good product as it is very affordable and does its makeup removing job well.
